title: Fix off-by-one in sumRange
prompt: The function sumRange(a, b) in stats.mjs must return the sum of all integers from a to b INCLUSIVE (e.g. sumRange(1, 5) === 15), but it currently returns the wrong value because of an off-by-one bug. Fix the bug in stats.mjs, then verify by running `node check.mjs` (exit code 0 means done).
